title: Fish Pond
tagline: Feel the tug, see the splash, find out what you caught!
howToPlay: Tap the water near a fish to cast, tap again when the bobber dips and the ! pops up, and tickle your catch before it flies into the picture book. Five places, 23 creatures, and surprises to find: big ones, sparkly shiny ones, a golden fish, a whale and treasure.
learning: Fun first: watching for the bite and tapping at just the right moment, and noticing who lives in which water
